name: Simple Menu Permissions
description: Defines granular per-menu permissions (view/edit/delete the menu, and add/edit/delete its links) plus a global 'create new menu' permission, so non-admins can manage specific menus without core's all-or-nothing 'administer menu'.
project_description:
Defines permissions for menus.

 It defines the "Create new menu" permission and the following permissions for each menu separately:

 - Create new menu

- View [menu_name] menu in menu list

- Add new links to [menu_name] menu

- Edit [menu_name] menu

- Edit links in [menu_name] menu

- Delete [menu_name] menu

- Delete links in [menu_name] menu
